## Acquired distinctions change enacted participation

The [next source and evidence study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PARTICIPATION-CONSEQUENCE-INTEGRATION.md) locates a stronger connection already present in the earlier architecture-learning branch: actual graph formation, paid recipient feedback, acquired candidate revision, a changed issued command and finite maintenance share one resource history. This is credited as an existing computational result. It is a different concrete history from the connected Lean successor above, and is not silently spliced into that successor.

At its selected reached entry, faithful and equally paid absent feedback leave the actor with the same final fuel and retained graphs but recipient reserves thirty and twenty respectively. A private-zero proxy also reaches thirty without faithful recipient evidence. The full records therefore distinguish causal use of an acquired relation from favorable outcome alone. The original negative conjunction remains: with the declared resources, earlier motor revision and the entire strict recipient-learning continuation have zero joint primary mass. These are preserved results, not new experiments.

This clarifies what participation means. A retained distinction can change the actual command and effect while anatomical topology remains fixed; topology change is not required for learned participation. A structural memory may instead be the altered material coupling itself. The [primary comparisons and published rival](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PARTICIPATION-CONSEQUENCE-COMPARATORS.md) test that interpretation without treating remodeling as automatic proof of learned retrieval. Relevant history, retained mediator and later use must be identified together, with current conditions and competing explanations specified.

The bounded formation/acquisition/use relation is consequently already established under local laws. Its stronger unresolved connections concern formation and revision of relevant access, target differentiation and the acquisition practice, and the recipient's actual use of delivered support. The recipient-reserve model does not represent the recipient's own ongoing organization. Shared generative reality neither supplies these missing explanations by naming them nor makes them fundamentally separate domains.
